title: Concept: PHP version disclosed in a response
description: A PHP version string in an error or debug output in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The version dates the interpreter, and the same response often confirms that display_errors is on.
applicability: Deployments that render a PHP version string in an error or debug output into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The version dates the interpreter, and the same response often confirms that display_errors is on.
